svg.text: Demean across configured axes; optionally divide by input
Packing and context axis come from the run
Apply frozen ICA matrix W after configured input
Identity initialisation adds input components to the U-Net
Apply pseudoinverse W+; select centre epoch.
Noisy centre minus reconstructed clean centre.
Convert the configured core output to a centre artifact.
Optionally remove prediction DC; restore the input scale.

ICA projection → Component U-Net encoder · flow

Component U-Net decoder → Inverse ICA · flow
Component U-Net encoder → Component U-Net decoder · skip: Matching encoder feature
Multichannel context → Centre artifact · skip: Noisy centre
Centre artifact → Deployment artifact output · flow
Deployment changes normalisation and objective; architecture parameters remain
Identity initialisation optionally adds the original ICA components before inverse projection.
